card.name: Gaps before section numbers and ranges
card.fires_on: Often the blank space or small joining mark just before a section number, superscript digit or grade range in drug labels, such as '( 2.2 )' or 'Grade 3 to 5'. It also fires on 'China' in Chinese-company news text.

modes.label: Space before section number
modes.description: Blank gap right before a numbered label cross-reference in parentheses after an indication or dosing line.

modes.label: Inside units and grades
modes.description: Gap or digit inside a unit exponent, grade range or number, just before the next digit.

modes.label: China in company names
modes.description: The word China within a Chinese company name in news about Africa.
modes.example: built by the<< China>> Water and Electric Company became immotorable
